context_purpose: Enforce one purchase per person in a limited release and deter multi-account scalping.

norm_violation_today.reason: Collecting national ID, birthday and ID photo to enforce a per-drop limit exceeds what an SMS-verified subscriber link needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Cannot stop one person with several lines, and cannot support dispute, refund or fraud follow-up that needs a contactable identity.

transmission_check.reason: No law is known to require the platform to keep ID for retail drops, so a nullifier-style flow is not blocked.

context_purpose: Give each fan one buying account for a presale so scalpers cannot run many accounts.

norm_violation_today.reason: Mobile plus OTP is proportionate, but demanding national ID and an ID photo for the strict case goes beyond the one-account purpose.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Cannot catch one person with several lines, and the ticketer loses a real identity for name-on-ticket or entry checks.

transmission_check.reason: Some ticketing rules may require real-name ticketing for certain events, which I cannot confirm, so a nullifier-only flow may not satisfy them.

context_purpose: Decide whether an absence or missed exam was medically justified so it can be excused or made up.

norm_violation_today.reason: The school receives diagnosis, department and ID number when it needs only that the person was unfit on given dates, and the copy circulates in chats and files.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing for ordinary absence; the school cannot see the diagnosis for notifiable-disease rules unless a separate field is added.

transmission_check.reason: School rules may name the diagnosis certificate as the required document, and I cannot confirm whether a narrower attestation is accepted.

context_purpose: Judge that an applicant lives stably at an address so a landlord or building committee can grant a tenancy or access.

norm_violation_today.reason: Full order screenshots reveal diet, schedule, spending and guests when only a count at an address is needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: An order count shows habit, not a legal right to occupy, and is easily gamed, so it is weaker evidence than a lease or utility bill.

transmission_check.reason: The applicant volunteers this informal evidence and no rule requires the full screenshots.

context_purpose: Confirm a child has served the exclusion period and may safely return so other children are protected.

norm_violation_today.reason: Schools collect disease name, symptoms and medication, and sometimes file photos of the note, when a cleared-to-return fact would do.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The nurse cannot see the disease name needed for class-level outbreak management and reporting of notifiable diseases.

transmission_check.reason: Health-department guidance and reporting duties may require the school to know the disease, and I cannot confirm the specific rules.

context_purpose: Assess whether a prospective or renewing tenant pays rent reliably before the landlord commits.

norm_violation_today.reason: Full passbook pages expose salary, merchants, balances and other accounts when only on-time rent payments matter.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A payment statistic does not show current income, ability to pay a higher rent, or a guarantor, which landlords often also want.

transmission_check.reason: Private landlords ask voluntarily and no rule is known to require full statements.

context_purpose: Prevent communicable disease spread in shared housing or care settings during an outbreak.

norm_violation_today.reason: A facility may be entitled to condition-specific information during an active outbreak, though full reports and folders of lab values exceed that.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Infection-control staff may need the named condition, test dates and contact tracing detail, which a bare cleared status hides.

transmission_check.reason: Communicable disease law or health authority direction may require more disclosure in an active case, and I cannot confirm the details.

context_purpose: Keep a community tournament fair by admitting only players at a stated rank and blocking smurf accounts.

norm_violation_today.reason: Login credentials or full screen-share expose email, purchases and friends when only a rank threshold is needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The proof does not stop borrowed or shared accounts unless tied to the entry handle, which the organizer must still verify.

transmission_check.reason: The player volunteers this to enter an informal event and no legal duty requires full account access.
